claim: 편심은 화물만이 아니라 컨테이너 자중을 포함한 총중량 기준으로 봅니다.
evidence: IM6 §2.1.1 builds LDD(C) from 'eccentricity of container CoG is 5% and 10%' (ISO 830, container incl. tare), so the IM6 statement holds. But Annex 7 §3.1.4 states the rule for the cargo: 'The eccentricity of the centre of gravity of the cargo should not exceed 5% in general'. The a7-load-distribution doc and its checkpoint use the cargo basis. As written, this checkpoint reads as if the gross basis replaces the cargo rule.
fix: IM6의 LDD(C)는 컨테이너 자중을 포함한 총중량 무게중심 편심으로 그립니다. 부속서 7 §3.1.4의 5%는 화물 무게중심 편심 기준이므로 두 기준을 모두 확인합니다.

evidence: 30 claims checked, 29 correct. Verified against MSC.1/Circ.1498 IM6 §1.2~3.3.4. Checks: three papers reproduced with permission; ISO 830 definitions; 30,480/4,000/26,480 kg; axle limits A16/B18/C20/D22.5 t and 2:1; the 29.2 t example at 6.7 m vs 6.39 m giving 18.9/21.1 t. Kingpin 15 t vs 9.8 t (18 t two-axle tractor, 8.2 t tare) and the 25% minimum loads match. The 'LLD' misprint in §3.1.1 is noted correctly. Also correct: 15 t / 22 t / 3.6% / GCM 44 t → 26 t but over route C, and 44 x 480 kg = 21.12 t, 25.12 t, 30+6+8, 1.024% / 1.020%. Korean limits of 10 t / 40 t with a 10% measurement tolerance (11 t / 44 t) match the published enforcement practice. The Cubestow vehicle parameters were not checked.
